description: Preview literal replacements or supplied copy changes for inspected MOGRT text and supplied caption artifacts. Preserve original text and evidence revisions with explicit approve/reject decisions. Does not translate, access native graphics/caption text or apply changes.

entries.description: Bounded copy-review entries; original text is preserved for later comparison.

kind.description: Supported review evidence; not native graphics or native caption editing.

proposed_text.description: Optional caller-reviewed replacement, including an empty string.

source_revision.description: Revision of the inspected text evidence; re-inspect before any later mutation.

target_id.description: Exact MOGRT clip or supplied caption-artifact target ID.

expected_review_revision.description: Revision from the initial review; required when selecting or rejecting entries. A changed input requires a new review.

find_text.description: Optional literal, case-sensitive search; regex is not executed.

rejected_ids.description: Explicitly rejected entry IDs. Unselected entries remain pending.

replace_text.description: Literal replacement, required together with find_text. Dollar signs have no special meaning.

selected_ids.description: Explicitly approved entry IDs. Omit for an initial review; an empty array approves nothing.

name: review_text_changes

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Review Text Changes
